ambiguities.source_text: Ensure we have a row for each month for each account i.e. 12 rows for each account
ambiguities.intent: An account is Provider, Interest and Max Monthly Deposit after cleaning; all current Provider labels are unique.

ambiguities.source_text: Update the Provider field so it is easy for customers to see in 1 field which accounts have additional conditions
ambiguities.intent: Append (Conditions Apply) when the indicator is Y.
Convert percentage strings to decimal annual rates.
Monthly rate is annual rate divided by 12.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the savings value in each account, each month after interest has been applied
ambiguities.ref:
for i in range(1, month + 1):
                
                
                months_interest = month - i + 1
                deposit_value = group.iloc[0]["Max Monthly Deposit"] * (1 + group.iloc[0]["Interest"] / 12) ** months_interest
                total += deposit_value
ambiguities.intent: Each monthly deposit earns interest starting in its deposit month; retain full precision during accumulation.

ambiguities.source_text: Create a field for the maximum possible savings a customer could get from each account
ambiguities.ref: df_expanded["Max Possible Savings"] = df_expanded.groupby("Provider")["Savings each month"].transform("max")
ambiguities.intent: Use the maximum monthly savings across the twelve months.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the maximum total interest a customer could get from each account
ambiguities.ref:
df_expanded["Total Interest"] = (
        df_expanded["Max Possible Savings"] - 
        (df_expanded["Max Monthly Deposit"] * 12)
    )
ambiguities.intent: Total Interest is final savings minus twelve deposits.

ambiguities.source_text: Rank the accounts by the maximum possible savings
ambiguities.ref:
provider_summary["Providers Ranked by Max Savings"] = (
        provider_summary["Max Possible Savings"]
        .rank(method="dense", ascending=False)
        .astype(int)
    )
ambiguities.intent: Use dense descending ranks of provider summaries, no gaps for ties.
Assign Sort consecutively starting at 1 after the required final ordering.
Sort by total-interest rank ascending, then Month ascending.
ambiguities.ref:
df_expanded = df_expanded.sort_values(
        by=["Providers Ranked by Total Interest", "Month"],
        ascending=[True, True]
    )
